description: This file defines functions and types for managing MCP (Multi-Cloud Provider) configurations within a plugin system, including loading, parsing, and inspecting MCP server configurations, with support for different bundle formats.

methods.name: resolveBundleMcpConfigPaths
methods.description: Resolves MCP configuration file paths based on raw config, root directory, and bundle format.

methods.name: extractMcpServerMap
methods.description: Extracts MCP server configurations from raw data.

methods.name: isExplicitRelativePath
methods.description: Checks if a path string is explicitly relative.

methods.name: expandBundleRootPlaceholders
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in paths with actual root directory.

methods.name: normalizeBundlePath
methods.description: Normalizes and resolves a given path.

methods.name: absolutizeBundleMcpServer
methods.description: Converts relative paths in MCP server config to absolute paths based on root and base directories.

methods.name: loadBundleFileBackedMcpConfig
methods.description: Loads MCP config from a file boundary, parsing JSON and extracting server configs.

methods.name: loadBundleInlineMcpConfig
methods.description: Loads MCP config directly from raw inline data.

methods.name: loadBundleMcpConfig
methods.description: Loads MCP configuration based on bundle format and manifest.

methods.name: inspectBundleMcpRuntimeSupport
methods.description: Inspects runtime support for MCP based on current configuration.

methods.name: loadEnabledBundleMcpConfig
methods.description: Loads enabled MCP configuration for a workspace, with fallback to empty config.
